The Prophet paid Abu Taiba a sa of dates for cupping him and had his masters lighten his tax; were the wage unlawful, he would not have paid it.
Abu Taiba, a slave, cupped the Prophet, who ordered him paid a Sa of dates and ordered his masters to reduce his tax.
An honest treasurer is one of two charitable persons; no post goes to one demanding it; the Prophet shepherded for pay, and he and Abu Bakr hire a pagan guide.
The Prophet was cupped and paid the cupper his wages in foodstuff, asking his masters to reduce his tax, and he never withheld anyone's wages.
